summary: Foundation slice for #1368: locked atomic JSON store (state_store.py) and first migrations for PM queue, fleet handoffs, and scheduled ops runs.
migration_impact: Corrupt or truncated JSON under .agentic/pm/queue.json, .agentic/fleet/handoffs.json, or .agentic/scheduled_ops/runs.json now raises CorruptStateError instead of being silently reset; repair or remove the file before resuming writes.
migration_guidance: 2. If CLI or MCP errors with CorruptStateError on these paths, inspect the JSON file and restore from backup or delete to recreate an empty store.
3. Follow-up PRs will migrate remaining .agentic writers listed in issue #1368.
agent_notes: Use plate_core.state_store.locked_json for new durable JSON stores; do not swallow JSONDecodeError on load. Epic #1383 / issue #1368 remaining modules migrate separately.
